title: Nihilism — The Cold Version
description:
The honest version of Nihilism starts by giving up the comforting part. Nihilism is a family of philosophical views that reject the existence of any objectively meaningful purpose, moral value, truth, knowledge, or related concepts. Nihilistic views span several branches of philosophy, including ethics, value theory, epistemology, and metaphysics.

Every serious account of Nihilism eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. Unlike existential nihilism, moral nihilism focuses specifically on moral phenomena rather than a higher meaning or purpose. In its broadest form, it is the metaethical view that there are no moral facts.
